about: Pradaxa (dabigatran), by brand name only, is supplied ten times from January to October 2026 to a 68-year-old woman.
Xarelto (rivaroxaban) is supplied five times from January to April 2026 to a 72-year-old man, in the middle of a 14-month history.

The only anticoagulant is Coumadin (warfarin), which is not named in this criterion, so it is not met; Pravachol and Xalatan are a cholesterol tablet and eye drops whose names resemble Pradaxa and Xarelto.
